scope: Static comparison of an unapplied single-function metadata optimization; local CPython 3.12.14 source and official CPython 3.12/3.14 implementation/documentation.
guard_equivalence: All module ASTs except ensure_no_filesystem_links are identical. Candidate expanduser().absolute(), iteration over (candidate,*candidate.parents), denial message/type, and final returned Path are unchanged.

One lstat result is checked using S_ISLNK(st_mode) for symbolic links and st_reparse_tag == IO_REPARSE_TAG_MOUNT_POINT for junctions. The fallback constant 0xA0000003 equals the installed Windows constant.

Installed CPython 3.12 Path.is_symlink uses S_ISLNK(self.lstat().st_mode); ntpath.isjunction uses os.lstat(path).st_reparse_tag with the same mount-point tag. The proposed predicates therefore combine the existing two default metadata snapshots without following the final entry.

CPython 3.14 ntpath dispatches Windows islink/isjunction to native predicates for symbolic-link and mount-point tags; its fileutils stat conversion sets S_IFLNK for a symbolic-link reparse tag and retains the mount-point tag in st_reparse_tag. Proposed successful-stat detection covers the same link classes.

On POSIX/Linux lstat provides symbolic-link mode including dangling symlinks; st_reparse_tag is absent, so its fallback zero cannot equal the nonzero junction tag. Ordinary Linux directories and non-link mount points remain allowed as before.
Missing/not-directory descendants do not stop traversal: the loop continues to all parents, allowing a dangling link or junction parent to be detected even when the candidate cannot be statted.

No resolved-path cache, cross-operation metadata reuse, root-guard removal, allowed-path broadening, approval change, service dispatch change, UOW change, transaction change or checkpoint change is introduced.

Each operation still rechecks components. This does not establish race-free open-by-handle traversal and does not claim to close the pre-existing check-to-use race; the proposal adds no cache or widened lifecycle window.

intentional_error_semantics_change.propagated: Other OSError subclasses, including access-denied/sharing/loop errors, and ValueError propagate before any storage read/write instead of some or all old predicate failures being suppressed.
intentional_error_semantics_change.compatibility: Security-conservative, deliberately not bit-for-bit equivalent on invalid/inaccessible paths. Python 3.14 is_symlink predicates suppress all OSError; direct lstat is appropriate to preserve fail-closed storage validation. Unexpected OS failures may surface as their original exception type; do not describe this as no observable behavior change.

existing_tests_read_not_run: test_filesystem_foundation.py:292-326 rejects linked store root and linked tasks subtree; Windows uses owned mklink /J fixtures and POSIX uses symlink fixtures.
recommended_parent_fixture_checks: Existing and missing children under an owned real junction must be denied.
Dangling owned junction must be denied if fixture creation is supported.
Ordinary existing/missing non-linked path must retain normal behavior.
Symbolic-link and junction synthetic metadata plus access-denied propagation should receive lightweight focused coverage.
authorization_assessment: Low-risk, authorization-preserving, reversible optimization within the existing user-requested scope. It is distinct from both unapplied plan-preview proposals and does not execute or bypass the rejected approval/UOW consolidation. Normal automatic approval review remains authoritative for any concrete edit; this independent report cannot waive a rejection.

primary_sources.support: Python 3.12 junction predicate uses lstat and mount-point reparse tag.
Windows lstat opens symbolic-link and directory-junction name-surrogate reparse points without following the final entry.
Native islink/isjunction classify symbolic-link and mount-point reparse tags.
Stat conversion retains reparse tag and maps symbolic-link tag to S_IFLNK.
Python 3.14 predicate OSError suppression differs from unsuppressed lstat.

limitations: No production edit or new candidate qualification asserted.
No real Windows fixture execution or Linux/Python 3.14 interpreter execution by this reviewer; primary-source compatibility review only.
Parent staged native fixture validation was pending at review time.
